title: Genesis bulk ATAC-seq sample sheet
description: One row per paired-end library. workflows/atac-seq.nf also checks the exact header, reference files, reference IDs and per-reference consistency.

sample_id.errorMessage: sample_id must start with a letter, digit or underscore and contain only letters, digits, underscores, periods and hyphens

species.errorMessage: species must start with a letter, digit or underscore and contain only letters, digits, underscores, periods and hyphens

read1_url.errorMessage: read1_url must be an HTTP or HTTPS URL

read2_url.errorMessage: read2_url must be an HTTP or HTTPS URL: bulk ATAC libraries are paired-end

reference_fasta.errorMessage: reference_fasta must be a gzipped FASTA basename ending in .fa.gz, .fasta.gz or .fna.gz

reference_genes.errorMessage: reference_genes must be a BED6 basename ending in .bed in the references folder, or - to skip TSS enrichment

organelle_contigs.errorMessage: organelle_contigs must be comma-separated contig names, or - for none
